title: Down and Out in Paris and London
author: George Orwell
summary: Orwell describes working as a kitchen drudge in Paris restaurants and then tramping through London lodging houses, noting the routines, humiliations and dark humour of being poor.
readIf: you want a vivid, observant look at poverty in the 1920s and 30s.
skipIf: you want a plotted narrative rather than episodes and social observation.
